title: Remove List and Tree MCP Tools Except Main Tree
description: Remove all list and tree MCP tools from the repo CLI/MCP server, keeping only the main `tree` tool. This consolidates the API surface by removing redundant granular list/tree tools that are superseded by the unified tree command.
summary: Removed all 15 granular list/tree MCP tools (policy_list, policy_tree, ticket_list, draft_list, goal_list, contributor_list, project_list, project_tree, folder_list, folder_tree, file_list, file_tree, section_list, section_tree, definition_list) and their handler functions. Added a single unified `tree` MCP tool that delegates to the existing monorepo tree infrastructure with query filtering. Updated canonical commands list in repoPolicy. All MCP schema tests pass (29 tools).
